title: Unit 7 Consolidation: Costa Rica
goal: Consolidate Costa Rican history, constitutional pacifism, biodiversity policies, welfare institutions, and contemporary development contradictions.
grammar: síntesis de léxico socioambiental, pacifismo institucional y análisis crítico del desarrollo

items: Synthesize Costa Rica's biological bridge geography and cloud forest ecosystems.
Explain the 1948 demilitarization and its lasting dividend for education and health.
Analyze the CCSS welfare model and the Nicoya Peninsula longevity phenomena.
Evaluate the Payment for Environmental Services (PSA) and green energy matrix.
Debate contemporary challenges: monocultures, migrant labor rights, and territorial disparities.
I can describe Costa Rican geography and biodiversity with precision.
I can discuss the historic decision to abolish the military in 1948 and its institutional impact.
I can explain the functioning of the CCSS and preventive healthcare teams (EBAIS).
I can analyze the balance between ecotourism conservation and intensive monoculture agroindustry.
